reason: The world begins small: 8.0 KB · 8k triangles · 1 light.

narration: You arrive without a before. There is dark, and then there is ground: cool, fine-grained, faintly giving underfoot, like ash that has long forgotten fire. Your breath makes the only sound. Far to the north, low against the blackness, a single pale light hangs, steady as a held note. It does not flicker, and you have the strange sense that it noticed you first.

facts.description: A vast flat plain of fine, pale grey ash-like sand, soft and slightly rippled by ancient winds. It stretches unbroken in every direction into darkness, faintly silvered by the distant light.
facts.placement: Underfoot at the Wanderer's position, extending in all directions.

facts.description: A single pale, blue-white light, about the size of a thumbnail at this distance, hanging just above the horizon. It burns perfectly steady and casts a thin silver sheen across the ash plain toward the Wanderer.
facts.placement: About 2 km due north of the Wanderer, low on the horizon.
